plugins.name: phro-humanize
plugins.description: Rewrites Korean text that reads as AI-written so it reads as written by a person: finds 85 AI-tell patterns in 10 categories and rewrites them. Based on epoko77-ai/im-not-ai (MIT).

plugins.name: phro-interactive-demo
plugins.description: Turn an app brief (features, flows, state rules) into a working, presentation-ready demo simulator.

plugins.name: phro-learning
plugins.description: Collect the AI and IT terms you meet while working with Claude: term-board picks them from Claude's answers into a desktop pane with a short meaning and an example for each.

plugins.name: phro-prompt-nudge
plugins.description: Watches your prompts and the conversation, then suggests a sharper next question above the prompt box.

plugins.name: phro-trend
plugins.description: Turns trending AI papers and a week of AI news into practical Korean briefs: what changed, how far to trust it, and where it fits in your stack.
